name: [UPDATE!] GHOUL:// RE
desc:
---- { Controls :
M1 -> Attack
M1 + CTRL -> Uppercut
M1 + M2 -> Feint
Space -> Jump
Space + LMB -> Aerial Attack
R -> Critical


E -> Equip Fist / Quinque Weapons
* Ctrl + E -> Equip Kagune
* Ctrl + 1 - 0 -> Switch between Kagune Stages

Z - X - C - Y -> Use Quinque / Kagune Skills
Ctrl + J -> To Activate Arata Mode / Sub mode

Q -> Dash / Dodge
Left Shift -> Sprint
RMB (During a Dash) -> Dash Cancel
RMB HOLD + Q -> Dash Cancel
F -> Block / Parry
V -> Carry
B -> Grip
* CTRL + B & CTRL + RMB -> Devour (Ghouls)

M -> Stat Menu
P -> Location Icons
Left Alt -> Shift-lock
